overview: Cross-reference records ITT's Japanese affiliate seeking return of dollar bonds to Japan by steamer; a conversation memo reports Shanghai Municipality and French Concession approved telephone rate increases to offset Chinese-dollar depreciation losses.

people.name: Frank C. Page
people.role: Representative of the International Telephone and Telegraph Corporation

people.name: Mackay
people.role: Official of the State Department’s Division of Far Eastern Affairs

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on return of Japanese affiliate’s dollar bonds
subfiles.about: Cross-reference to a memorandum concerning an ITT affiliate’s request for the return of Japanese dollar bonds to Japan by Japanese steamer.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: ITT's Japanese affiliate requested its dollar bonds be returned to Japan by steamer, per Page's phone call.

subfiles.title: Memorandum of conversation on increased Shanghai telephone rates
subfiles.from: Mackay, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Frank C. Page reports official approval of higher Shanghai telephone rates intended partly to compensate ITT for losses from Chinese-currency depreciation.
subfiles.summary: Page tells Mackay that Shanghai and French Concession authorities approved a December telephone rate increase, partly offsetting losses from the Chinese dollar's decline.

interest: Shows 1940 ITT bond-return request to Japan and approved Shanghai telephone rate hikes offsetting currency depreciation.
